name: Room Bloom
summary:
Discover a different side of your everyday space. Room Bloom brings four atmospheric mixed-reality scenes into your room, with effects that respond to scanned walls, floors and furniture.

ROOM BLOOM
Release colourful motes, gather them close and scatter them with a pulse, accompanied by gentle ambient music.

RAIN ROOM
Settle into the sound of rain as drops fall around you and splash against the surfaces in your room.

FRACTAL GROVE
Plant intricate geometric forms on real surfaces. Reshape your grove, bend
